$schema: Single source of truth for every showcased work. Pages render generated blocks from this file via scripts/site-gen.py; hand-edited blocks fail scripts/content-sync.sh.

works.title: The Transformer Architecture, Animated
works.blurb: The mechanism behind frontier language models, built up step-by-step: tokens, positional encodings, scaled dot-product attention, multi-head subspaces, and the feed-forward stack.

figures.title: The Transformer Blueprint
figures.caption: Tokens climb through stacked attention and feed-forward blocks to the LM head.

works.title: The Distributed Event Fabric
works.blurb: High-throughput edge ingress, partitioned log streaming, and Raft consensus — events you can watch cross the wire, not boxes that fade in.

figures.title: Distributed Event Fabric
figures.caption: Smart orthogonal routing with fillet corners, edge proxies, and a live telemetry counter.

works.title: Circles That Draw a Square Wave
works.blurb: Fourier analysis as spinning mechanical dials: harmonic circles at odd integer frequencies stacking into a sharp square wave with scrolling history traces.

figures.title: Harmonic Epicycles
figures.caption: Four harmonic circles rotating at odd integer frequencies synthesize a square wave.

works.title: Sorting, Staged
works.blurb: Eight bars perform insertion sort directed entirely by a build-time timeline function: every comparison lights a tick, every swap is emitted algorithmically.

figures.title: Sorting, Choreographed
figures.caption: Insertion sort staged with animated bars, pairwise swaps, and algorithmic tallying.

works.title: A Matrix Is a Machine
works.blurb: Linear algebra as spatial transformation: a 2×2 matrix bends the coordinate grid, basis vectors lead, and the determinant collapses through zero.

figures.title: A Matrix Is a Machine
figures.caption: The basis vectors lead, the coordinate grid follows, and matrix chips track the columns.

works.title: Rolling Downhill: Gradient Descent
works.blurb: Optimization topography: steepest-descent vector fields, contour tracing, and why the learning-rate step size decides convergence.

figures.title: The Loss Surface
figures.caption: Concentric contour rings and the radial gradient vector field pointing uphill.

works.title: Morph Lab: Generative Vector Kinetics
works.blurb: Continuous vector interpolation across three strategies: vertex index matching, curved circular trajectories, and proportional length remapping.

figures.title: Morph Lab
figures.caption: One blob, three interpolation strategies, synthesized cubic Bezier control points at 60 FPS.

works.title: Fluid Typography & Spatial Depth
works.blurb: Editorial motion design and tactile digital physics: split-text baseline emergence, 2.5D perspective tilt, and real-time GPU frosted glass.

figures.title: Kinetic Typography & Glass
figures.caption: Split-text baseline emergence, 2.5D perspective tilt, and real-time GPU frosted glass.

works.title: Where Keys Live: Hash Tables
works.blurb: Hash tables staged as theatre: a hash you can follow by eye, collision chaining, and constant-time key lookups without search iterations.

figures.title: Two Keys, One Bucket
figures.caption: A hash collision triggers linked-list overflow chaining below the target bucket.
